C9000317.statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 317 (Thomason model structures in all strict higher dimensions.; papers: Thomason Model Structures in Every Strict Higher Dimension; Lean status: Partially/Comparator formalized (lean/docs/317.md)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.

C_COUNIVERSAL.statement: For every small poset sieve A in E with a right-adjoint retraction, every strict attaching map c_n N(A) -> X, and every positive finite n or n = omega, X -> X amalg_{c_n N(A)} c_n N(E) is a Street weak equivalence.

L_PRISM_CHAIN.statement: Under the exact sieve, endpoint agreement and constant-upper-complement hypotheses of lem:relative-prism, the normalized append formula defines a positive augmentation-preserving chain map in every degree.

L_PRISM_WHOLE.statement: The simplexwise relative prism is compatible with every ordinal operator and assembles into a whole right Gray cylinder strictly stationary on the old subcategory, including retained lower boundaries of zero top chains.

L_FINITE_REFLECTION.statement: For each positive finite n, the right interval internal hom into a strict n-category is a strict n-category; cylinders descend uniquely through reflection with their endpoint and restriction equalities.

L_PUSHOUT_GLUE.statement: Whole cylinders stationary on the attaching source glue over arbitrary strict n-category pushouts without injectivity, freeness, or cofibrancy hypotheses.

L_LABEL_FIBERS.statement: Full label fibers and object sets of the actual pushout have the stated colimit descriptions, so sieve covers and their intersections remain actual full sieve subcategories after arbitrary object and cell identifications.

L_GRAY_NERVE.statement: The positive natural Alexander-Whitney diagonal sends right Gray cylinders to simplicial homotopies, preserving whole stationarity.

L_FINITE_INDUCTION.statement: The greatest-new-element zigzag and finite sieve-cover induction prove couniversality for every finite E simultaneously for all attaching targets and maps.

L_FILTERED_PASSAGE.statement: Finite ir-stable full subposets form a cofinal filtered system; under a fixed arbitrary X their pushouts recover the whole pushout, and Street weak equivalences pass to the colimit without monomorphic transitions.

C_AUDIT_KERNEL.statement: Lean 4.31.0 proves the unbounded tuple correction, exact edge criterion, sieve-to-control implication and arbitrary adjunction/pushout gluing. The ledger derives closed_kernel; this graph leaves independent statement-fidelity approval open.

L_APPEND_EDGE_CRITERION.statement: For every poset and a <= b <= c, the normalized edge identity [a,c]-[a,b]=[b,c] holds exactly when a=b or b=c.

L_APPEND_TERMINAL_CORRECTION.statement: Append control implies the terminal normalized tuple correction B-B'=G for every finite list, without a bound on dimension or poset cardinality.

L_ADJOINT_PUSHOUT_GLUE.statement: For any adjunction L left adjoint to R, compatible maps from L of the two legs of any actual pushout extend uniquely over L of its apex, with no injectivity restriction.

L_STRICT_PRESENTATIONS.statement: Saturated defined-term and equality derivations construct actual small strict-category colimits, including all composites made possible by new boundary identifications, in every stated dimension.

L_APPEND_DESCENT.statement: Under append control, the full image-vertex set of each simplex is ordered, the positive append chain maps are compatible with all ordinal operators, and they assemble into an omega Gray cylinder stationary on every subposet on which the endpoints agree.

C_APPEND_PRISM_CRITERION.statement: For monotone f<=g on every small poset, the prescribed append prism is a positive chain map in all degrees exactly under append control; it then gives whole stationary right cylinders in all positive finite dimensions and omega. Novelty and the full categorical interpretation are not kernel-certified.
